S0642.reason: The state statute discriminates against nonresidents in violation of the Dormant Commerce Clause, and the federal court should hear the merits rather than abstain.

S0122.reason: The friend lacked genuine criminal intent (feigned agreement) and as an agreed-upon nonparticipant/police informant cannot be convicted of conspiracy or larceny.

S0549.reason: Fetal hemoglobin has higher oxygen affinity, so retention would increase oxygen binding, though this impairs tissue release rather than helping it.
